resolution.note: task-records worktree exempt from lane budget; tests in lane.test.ts and task-publish.test.ts fail without the change

title: Task publish is not refused by the agent lane budget
body: Evidence 2026-11-18: `krn task publish` exited 64 with "lane budget: 6 live lane worktrees ... (maximum 6, KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE)" while six agent lanes ran: publishing task records needs a short-lived task-records worktree, and the lane cap (meant to bound paid agent sessions) refused it, so closes and new records could not reach main.
Outcome: task-record publication (and its task-records-* worktree) is exempt from the lane budget and is not counted as a live lane.
Proof: a test with KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE live lanes asserts `krn task publish` still creates its worktree and ships; a task-records worktree does not count toward the budget of the next lane start.
